parameters.formula: effective(r,t) = drift_priority(r) + R * max(0, t - release_r) / H; highest effective priority first; ties by request_order_key
parameters.selection_criterion: largest H (weakest age escalation) among k*tau, k in (1,2,4,8,16), such that on the training workload (a) no request waits more than 60 s (unfinished requests counted at their observed age) and (b) p99 request wait <= 1.25 x consecutive-pair; if none qualifies the smallest H is used and the configuration is PROVISIONAL
parameters.calibration_data: training partition only: 13509 requests released before the holdout boundary 21920.355064249998
parameters.overtake_bound: a request can only be overtaken by requests released at most H seconds after it (conditional bound; not a maximum-wait guarantee)

scenarios.name: historical_baseline
scenarios.source: workload-derived: (last - first arrival) / (N - 1) of the evaluated workload, i.e. its mean inter-arrival gap
scenarios.interpretation: existing historical simulation assumption; offered load N/(N-1) by construction; not hardware capacity

scenarios.name: slower_device
scenarios.source: sensitivity assumption: baseline x 1.10 (10% longer service duration)
scenarios.interpretation: modelling assumption only; not a device specification

scenarios.name: faster_device
scenarios.source: sensitivity assumption: baseline x 0.90 (10% shorter service duration)
scenarios.interpretation: modelling assumption only; not a device specification

scenarios.name: recorded_cadence_reference
scenarios.source: recorded 14-circuit cycle cadence: 4.88 s / 14 (stated as 0.3486 s)
scenarios.interpretation: a recorded logging cadence of the original experiment; NOT verified hardware capacity

config.heldout_label_caveat: The automated pair decisions in the registry CSV were generated using held-out observations. They are not independently validated against the same held-out data, so this evaluation cannot be read as independent proof of scheduler accuracy. The CSV test statistics are not used to refit the drift model or the priority function, and the drift priorities themselves are not scientifically validated (persistence validation was inconclusive).
limitations: no capacity value is verified hardware capacity
recorded outcomes replayed; not a QPU experiment
model-derived comparison error is not measured reliability; the drift model has not shown deployment-faithful skill
